title: Warm Panettone French Toast
description: A delicious breakfast dish made with panettone bread, perfect for a cold morning. This recipe is vegan-friendly and uses a flavorful garlicky syrup to add extra flavor.

ingredients.name: non-dairy milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, whisk together non-dairy milk and maple syrup.
2. Add the minced garlic to the milk mixture and stir to combine.
3. Slice the panettone bread into 1-inch thick slices.
4. Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
5. Grease the pan with coconut oil.
6. Dip each bread slice into the milk mixture, coating both sides evenly.
7. Place the coated bread slices on the skillet or griddle.
8. Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
9. Repeat with the remaining bread slices.
10. Serve warm, garnished with additional maple syrup if desired.
